When the key is missing, binarySearch returns minus the insertion point minus one; find where the key would go.

Compare live view versus copy, mutability, null handling, and whether changes to the backing array show through.
List floor, ceiling, higher, lower and sub-map views, and connect them to problems like time-based lookups or ranges.
Mention access-order mode and removeEldestEntry, then discuss thread safety, and a hash map plus doubly linked list alternative.

Compare synchronized wrappers, concurrent collections, copy-on-write lists and immutable collections, with their trade-offs.
